kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY STATUS REPORT
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - New vents opened at Kīlauea summit eruption site last night. Kīlauea summit region is pressurized above the level required to start a fountaining episode. Additional changes to the type of activity/eruption location could potentially occur.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
